revision_basis.diagnosis: Fresh-process isolation proved the native abort is target-local to the non-Cashahuacra replay path rather than cross-target process state. Revision 0.7 replayed the already-computed D8 topology by constructing a second Pysheds Grid and re-running DEM conditioning/flowdir/catchment/distance operations. Revision 0.9 removes only that redundant second native-grid execution. For the five geometries originally generated with Pysheds catchment semantics, it replays the mathematically identical upstream set and weighted D8 distance directly from the unchanged first-pass D8 flow-direction array to the unchanged rasterio containing-cell center pour point, then requires >=0.995 frozen-polygon coverage and Jaccard. No observed metric value was used to choose this change.

semantic_equivalence_constraints.input_flow_direction_array: unchanged first-pass Pysheds D8 flowdir on binary-identical frozen geometry-generation DEM
semantic_equivalence_constraints.pour_point: unchanged rasterio containing-cell center for frozen outlet row/col
semantic_equivalence_constraints.catchment_definition: all cells whose unique D8 downstream path reaches the pour-point cell
semantic_equivalence_constraints.weighted_distance_definition: sum of 30 m orthogonal and sqrt(2)*30 m diagonal D8 links along the unique downstream path

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output is frozen by hash
read sealed outcomes before the allowed unblind
use any metric value from a worker to select, tune, drop or rerun a target under different scientific semantics
move an outlet or alter/expand a frozen basin polygon
change DEM conditioning, slope algorithm, channel threshold or metric inclusion rule
accept a regenerated DEM whose binary GeoTIFF SHA256 differs from the frozen geometry-generation DEM hash
relax the 0.995 topology replay coverage or Jaccard gates to force a pass
treat a worker crash, missing artifact or topology mismatch as zero, dry, inactive or scientifically usable
